name: gitleaks own testdata corpus
notes: gitleaks ships a small ``testdata/`` corpus of source files
containing credential-shaped strings the project's own rules
are expected to flag. Running secscan secrets against the same
directory and matching the rule_id set is a parity check: does
secscan's integration layer surface what gitleaks itself surfaces?
Match logic: count of unique (file, rule_id) tuples in
secscan output >= count emitted by gitleaks direct on the same
directory at the same gitleaks version. Recall here doubles as
a regression test for the gitleaks-tempfile fix from Phase 2-F.
